verdict.rationale: Fellow offers pieces of meeting prep. Past transcripts are searchable for context (fellow-docs-21), open action items can be listed and filtered (fellow-docs-5, fellow-docs-45), and you can ask an AI assistant via MCP about prior decisions (fellow-docs-32). Assembling a pre-call brief, though, would mean asking manually or building it yourself on the API and an LLM (fellow-docs-31). missing for 10: an automatic pre-meeting brief surfaced before the call, matching of past meetings by the same attendees, calendar-triggered prep, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
